verdict.rationale: Baseten ships an official CLI (Truss/`truss push`, `baseten model push`, and the `baseten-switch` CLI referenced in docs) for deploying models, training jobs, and routing coding-agent traffic, backed by first-party docs and the open-source Truss GitHub repo. Missing for 10: a dedicated CLI reference/command list and independent hands-on confirmation of CLI reliability beyond docs/GitHub claims.
